PROFILE SUMMARY 
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt Certified (KPMG Sponsored) professional with 10+ years driving Process Excellence, PMO, and Digital 
Transformation across GCC, NBFC, and Heavy Manufacturing sectors. Proven track record of delivering USD 1.5M+ in annual savings 
through RPA-UiPath automation, DMAIC-led project execution, VSM, and Kaizen-based continuous improvement. Adept at leveraging 
Power BI, SQL, and AI-powered tools for real-time governance and data-driven decision-making across cross-functional GCC, US, and 
India-based teams. 
I am currently pursuing my Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification from the Indian Statistical Institute (ISI). 
I have personally led all 10 Green Belt projects, managing them through the project lifecycle and driving them toward successful 
completion. 
Yes, I have managed the end-to-end Lean Six Sigma programme lifecycle across Black Belt, Green Belt, and Yellow Belt initiatives, 
including nominations, mobilisation, training coordination, assessments, project allocation, mentoring, certification, progress tracking, 
and reporting. 
I have trained 100 employees in Lean Six Sigma and Continuous Improvement, comprising approximately 65 Yellow Belt and 35 Green 
Belt participants. 
Yes. I have developed two structured training modules — ACE 1 and ACE 2 — covering Lean Six Sigma and Continuous Improvement 
concepts, methodologies, tools, and practical application. 
I have worked across multiple process-improvement tracks, including Billing, Billing Rewrite, and other operational processes. Through 
process and data discovery, I identified 39 improvement opportunities. Of these, 30 were converted into automation initiatives, 6 into 
process-improvement initiatives, and 3 into technology-enhancement initiatives. This involved understanding the As-Is process, 
identifying pain points and waste, analysing root causes and data, and developing appropriate To-Be solutions. 
Yes. I established and drove a Continuous Improvement culture across an organisation of approximately 1,365 employees. I introduced 
a biweekly Process Health Check (PHC) mechanism covering process landscapes, SOPs, Continuous Improvement trackers, employee 
idea submissions, FMEA, quality checks, error logs, and CAPA. This created a structured mechanism for employees to identify, track, 
and implement improvement opportunities across the organisation. 
Approximately 30% of my role involved engagement and consulting with senior stakeholders, while 70% was focused on execution and 
implementation. My stakeholder responsibilities included understanding business problems, presenting data-driven findings, 
recommending improvement opportunities, obtaining alignment, and providing updates on the progress and impact of improvement 
initiatives.

Drove full digital transformation of the loan lifecycle via RPA and workflow automation. Reduced TAT from 35 days → 7 days (80%),

Designed multi-year Lean Transformation roadmap across 5 business units integrating VSM, FMEA, and Kaizen events. Delivered 20%

VoC Analytics Framework | Mahindra Home Finance 
Established a VoC framework using Google Analytics and NPS/CSAT data to prioritize product features. Resulted in 13.5% improvement 
in customer retention and 18% CSAT uplift. 
CI Tracker Digitization: Excel → PowerApps | Clean Harbors 
Led end-to-end digitization of CI tracker with real-time dashboards and automated alerts. Improved process visibility by 60%, reduced 
manual reporting by 5 hrs/week.
